title: Chapter 273
text:
A hundred boxes were neatly stacked into a small hill. It was a rare scene, and the players could not help but temporarily stop buying and watch curiously.

So Poor That Only Has Money took a deep breath and quickly opened the boxes. The onlookers craned their necks, and their faces gradually changed from anticipation to astonishment, and then to ridicule.

All hundred boxes were opened, and the best one was a blue submachine gun. The discarded parts were piled up into a small hill, and So Poor That Only Has Money's face turned green.

"A blue equipment in a hundred consecutive hits, good, this wave is very strong."

"Chief, please accept my worship."

"You can't change your fortune, big brother."

"New Expansion Pack: Galaxy — Destruction of the Tycoons."

"Why do I feel so good …" Someone was gloating.

So Poor That Only Has Money grabbed his hair in distress, looking depressed. Just like his ID, he was a tycoon and was used to throwing money. This method was successful most of the time. With money, he could do whatever he wanted.

Lottery events were his favorite. He did not care whether he earned or lost, but he liked the moment of pleasure when he got something good. However, he was defeated by Han Xiao.

No matter how many consecutive draws there were, there was no guarantee. Just like lottery tickets, it all depended on luck and probability. So Poor That Only Has Money felt that there was a high probability of getting something good, but his face was so black that people could not bear to look at it.

Although it was good to be a tycoon, Han Xiao treated them equally. He did not want to break the rules because of tycoons. His target customer group was all players with a large base, so that more people could participate in this event and make it a "main city feature," not an event that only belonged to tycoons. After all, the number of boxes was limited, and there was no guarantee for consecutive draws to avoid one person buying too many boxes.

If there was a guarantee for consecutive draws, other tycoons or guilds would follow suit. Every batch of limited boxes would be bought by a few tycoons, and other players would have fewer opportunities to participate. This would gradually reduce the attraction of the event, and long-term development was the way to go.

People had a herd mentality. Once it was a group's hobby, needs, and habits, the overall impact on the player group was different.

So Poor That Only Has Money wanted to buy more, and this made the other players unhappy. A hundred consecutive draws was fine. They would treat it as something new. The number of boxes was limited, and it would be too much to buy more.

Seeing that the crowd was stirred up and that he was so poor that he only had money left, he could only give up. He awkwardly scratched his head and walked to the side.

Beside him, King of Single Draw had a look of disdain on his face as he said to the crowd beside him, "Did you see that? There's no skill in throwing money at all. There's only a large amount of observation and research. Calculating the drop rate through calculation is the way to go."

As he spoke, the King of Single Draw was brimming with confidence. He grinned, and his teeth and glasses flashed at the same time. "Next, watch my performance!"

Leading the crowd to Han Xiao, the King of Single Draw was fully focused on his calculations. After the players had bought the boxes, he suddenly shouted, scaring the crowd. Then, he squeezed to the front of the line and bought the next box.

"Hehe, based on my experience, there must be good stuff in this box."

The King of Single Draw's confidence was off the charts. He opened the box under everyone's expectant gazes.

Everyone fell silent with strange looks in their eyes.

The atmosphere was very awkward. The King of Single Draw's mouth twitched. He coughed dryly and said, "You should know that this is a matter of probability. If the first time doesn't work, try a few more times. I'm sure something good will come out!"

However, the next four singles were all black, and his eyes became more and more suspicious.

"Can you do it or not?"

"Bullsh * t, next time, next time, it will definitely be purple!" The King of Single Draw's eyes were red, and he was panting like a drunk gambler. He bought a new box, closed his eyes, and murmured, "Gods and deities, please bless my luck this time. Amitabha, may I have good luck."

After muttering more than ten times, he felt his palms heat up, as if an inexplicable energy had descended upon him.

All kinds of famous sayings flashed through the Half A Cigarette When Lonely's mind. "Where there's a will, there's a way", "If there's a will, there's a way", "If there's a problem, then there's a way", "If there's a problem, then there's a way", and so on …

"There's definitely something this time!" The King of Single Draw suddenly opened his eyes. His confidence surged. He shouted and opened the box!

A pile of trash.

The King of Single Draw stood in place, dazed.

"Why … why is it like this? Could it be that the laws I researched are all fake? Opening the box is fake, this world is fake, fake, it's all fake! "

In the crowd, Half A Cigarette When It's Lonely touched his wallet. It was finally his turn. He hesitated for a while and said, "I'll buy one."

This was the first time he bought one. He was hesitant the previous few times. Although three thousand aquamarine dollars was not a lot, he was just a normal player. His wealth was hard to come by, and he was reluctant to spend it. However, many players had obtained good equipment through this event, and he was tempted.

In the end, he decided to buy one box.

Half A Cigarette When It's Lonely's goal was very low. He would be satisfied with just green equipment. He did not even dare to think about blue or purple equipment.

Half A Cigarette When It's Lonely ran to the side, held his breath and opened the box.

Purple light rushed into his eyes!

"Purple, purple … purple equipment?!"

Half A Cigarette When It's Lonely was stunned. He was so excited that his whole body trembled.

The players around him all looked at him with envy.

"Another lucky guy."

"Tsk, I want a purple equipment too."

Every time, someone would get a purple equipment. Although it was rare, the players had seen many people get purple equipment, so they were used to it. After a while of envy, they no longer cared.

Half A Cigarette When It's Lonely picked up the purple equipment and played with it. Suddenly, he had an impulse.

"Why don't … I buy another one to try my luck?"

Half A Cigarette When It's Lonely calmed himself down and bought another box. He opened it casually.

Purple light again!

Half A Cigarette When It's Lonely opened his mouth wide, and his heart was hit by a huge surprise.

The surrounding players looked over again and were amazed.

"Another purple equipment? You're so lucky. "

"Wow, hurry up and take a breath."

"Two draws, two wins. Why don't you go buy a lottery ticket?"

"Tsk, so what if you're lucky? Every dog has its day. It'll be my turn next year."

"Brother, I'll allow you to show off, but don't go overboard."

Some were envious, some were impressed, and some were jealous.

So Poor All That Is Money looked helpless. His 100 consecutive draws could not compare to two random draws. What kind of world was this? Where did the privilege of being a tycoon go?!

King of Single Draw gritted his teeth. He was on the verge of breaking down. He screamed in his heart, I must've let him take the hit. The purple equipment was originally mine!

"Why don't … I buy another one?" Half A Cigarette When It's Lonely touched his wallet. He had just over 3000 left. He made up his mind and bought another one. He was like a gambler who had tasted the sweetness and fell into the abyss of gambling.

"Can I win this time?" Half A Cigarette When Lonely suddenly felt a little regretful. He was already extremely lucky to have gotten it twice in a row. The chances of getting it three times in a row was too low. Moreover, there were only three Purple equipment in each batch. If he had gotten it, wouldn't that mean that he had gotten all the Purple equipment in the batch?

He opened the box for the third time with a nervous heart. The familiar purple light overflowed!

Half A Cigarette When It's Lonely was stunned. All the surrounding players were stunned.

Damn, he won all three single draws! What kind of luck is this?!

No, this can't be called luck. This is f * cking luck!

Everyone looked at the stunned Half A Cigarette When It's Lonely in shock.
